proof_body:
by
  intro f a b hab hf
  have hm : Cauchy (Filter.map f (nhdsWithin a (Set.Ioi a))) := by
    rw [Metric.cauchy_iff]
    refine ⟨inferInstance, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.1 hf ε hε
    have hη : 0 < min (b - a) (δ / 2) := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨f '' Set.Ioo a (a + min (b - a) (δ / 2)), Filter.image_mem_map (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by linarith)), ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have h1 := min_le_left (b - a) (δ / 2)
    have h2 := min_le_right (b - a) (δ / 2)
    refine h x ⟨hx.1, by linarith [hx.2]⟩ y ⟨hy.1, by linarith [hy.2]⟩ ?_
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2, hy.1, hy.2]
  exact CompleteSpace.complete hm
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a < b → UniformContinuousOn f (Set.Ioo a b) → ∃ L : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin a (Set.Ioi a)) (nhds L)
